quantize_tensor_to_ggml_format: quantize a pytorch tensor to a specified GGML quantization type like q4_0 or q8_0 using ggml_quant
register_custom_quantization_type: register a new quantization block function under a name in the GGML_QUANT_TYPE registry using register_qtype
quantize_with_chunked_memory_optimizatio: quantize large tensors in memory-efficient chunks using make_qx_quants_chunk with configurable bits and rmse type
quantize_k_series_blocks: quantize model weight blocks to Q2_K through Q6_K formats using the registered q2_k through q6_k quant block functions
quantize_with_rmse_refinement: quantize tensor data with iterative RMSE refinement using make_q3_quants or make_qx_quants for improved accuracy
